status: Proposed profiles; scope-bound implementation, not standards certification

profiles.scope: Existing DDN notation
Start/end, process, decision, I/O, document and predefined process; named branches.
validation: start has no incoming edge; end has no outgoing edge
decisions have >=2 distinct nonempty branch labels
every process reachable from a start and can reach an end

profiles.scope: Numbered three-compartment processes; open-ended stores and external entities.
validation: data flows cannot directly connect two non-process elements
unsupported: automatic context balancing across arbitrary diagrams

profiles.scope: Circular processes; parallel-line stores; rectangular external entities.
Class/interface attribute and operation compartments; package tabs; component markers; generalization/dependency/realization.
Actors, use-case ellipses, associations, include/extend/generalization.
Requirement IDs/text, satisfies/verifies/derives links.
Entity rectangles; field-derived attribute ovals with key underlining; binary association diamonds.
validation: binary association mapping with stable provenance

profiles.scope: Rows/roles/cells derived from responsibility relations.
validation: one A and at least one R per row

profiles.scope: Processes by data objects; cells from access relations.
Model-to-matrix projection with provenance.
Span-aware fixed column panels containing shared model references.
Nine canonical Business Model Canvas blocks on a fixed 10-column grid; span-aware panels with shared model references.
validation: all nine required block panels present (DDN-PJ080)

profiles.scope: Nine canonical Lean Canvas blocks on a fixed 10-column grid; span-aware panels with shared model references.
validation: all nine required block panels present (DDN-PJ080)

profiles.scope: Four macro-environment panels (political, economic, social, technological) in one strip.
Six macro-environment panels in two rows of three.
Center competitive-rivalry panel with the four surrounding force panels on a 3-column grid.
Says/thinks/does/feels quadrants around a center persona panel; panel items are declared notes.
Four perspective panels (financial, customer, internal process, learning & growth); each item list states declared objectives.
Typed field-key table bound to explicit records.
Native SVG quantitative marks; numeric/categorical coordinates; record provenance.
Categorical axes on radial spokes; one shared 0..max scale over all points; one polygon per series; record provenance.
Ordered stage bands; widths encode one value per stage; record provenance.
UTC date intervals mapped to a fixed axis; milestones and dependency overlays.
Cause-to-parent DAG projected onto a spine and measured branches; repeated occurrences retain source identity.
validation: cause cycles, orphan edges, depth/occurrence bounds

profiles.scope: Source-derived numeric, categorical or threshold cell encodings with visible missing state.
validation: declared finite scales; typed values; unique cell

profiles.scope: Shared-scale series/layers and explicit bounded transformations with record provenance.
validation: numeric domains, units, bin boundaries, totals, quartile/whisker conventions

profiles.scope: One initial state, explicit terminal states, events and typed guards; safe trace evaluator does not execute actions.
validation: reachability, event determinism, terminal rules, trace legality

profiles.scope: Typed conjunction predicates; unique/first/collect hit policies; bounded partition proof and evaluation.
validation: domain types, overlaps, coverage, shadowing, budgets

profiles.scope: One level of child views, source mappings, scoped SVG IDs, preserved scales and publication checks.
validation: span collisions; view cycles; child limits; text scale

profiles.scope: Adds subjects, extension-point targets, conditions and classifier generalization to the declared subset.
validation: subject references; extension-point existence; condition declaration; acyclic generalization

profiles.scope: Composite, derived/multivalued attributes, keys and partial keys, weak entities and identifying binary associations; min/max participant annotations.
validation: field metadata; identifying owner references; participation bounds

profiles.scope: Adds on-page connectors, matched off-page continuations, storage and non-control annotations.
validation: control reachability; annotation separation; continuation contracts

profiles.scope: One percentage value on a semicircular dial with an optional target marker; record provenance.
validation: value and target finite numbers in 0..100 (DDN-PJ075)

profiles.scope: Supplied open/high/low/close per category or date; wick low-high, body open-close; record provenance.
validation: finite numeric open/high/low/close on every record (DDN-PJ076)
high >= low and open/close within [low, high] (DDN-PJ077)
category or date x; numeric x rejected (DDN-PJ030)

profiles.scope: Hierarchical tiles from dotted category paths; slice-and-dice layout; area encodes one value; record provenance.
validation: tile values nonnegative finite numbers (DDN-PJ078, DDN-PJ032)
dotted paths of at most 3 levels (DDN-PJ030)

profiles.scope: Explicit source→target flows; depth columns from pure sources; ribbon thickness encodes value; record provenance. Duplicate (source,target) pairs are allowed: ribbons stack in declaration order.
validation: target is a property binding, not a numeric reference (DDN-PJ030)
no aggregation or series binding (DDN-PJ031, DDN-PJ030)
endpoints are distinct nonempty category text (DDN-PJ032)
flow values are positive finite numbers (DDN-PJ108, DDN-PJ032)

profiles.scope: People and systems and their interactions; no internal structure, no field-level endpoints.
validation: participants limited to c4.person and c4.system
no attribute fields on c4 kinds

profiles.scope: Containers/stores/queues inside one system boundary frame.
validation: participants limited to c4.container, c4.store, c4.queue plus boundary c4.system and external c4.person
exactly one frame scoped to a selected c4.system; members cover every selected interior node
no attribute fields on c4 kinds

profiles.scope: Components inside one container boundary frame.
validation: participants limited to c4.component plus boundary c4.container and external c4.person/c4.system/c4.store
exactly one frame scoped to a selected c4.container; members cover every selected interior node
no attribute fields on c4 kinds

profiles.scope: Single-root reporting hierarchy of org/team/role participants, rendered with the native tree layout.
validation: participants limited to organization, team, role, analysis.role (DDN-PF007)
exactly one root — one node with no incoming reports_to edge (DDN-PJ102)
no node has multiple managers (DDN201, layout stage)

profiles.scope: Deliverable-oriented single-root decomposition tree of analysis.task nodes; top-down native tree layout.
validation: exactly one root — one node with no incoming analysis.decomposes edge (DDN-PJ102)
no node has multiple parents (DDN201, layout stage)

profiles.scope: Single central topic with alternating left/right branches over concept-family nodes; native mindmap layout.
validation: participants limited to object, entity, term, domain (DDN-PF007)
exactly one root — one node with no incoming assoc edge (DDN-PJ102)
no node has multiple parents; declared root must be a hierarchy root (DDN201, DDN202, layout stage)

profiles.scope: Concept-family nodes joined by explicitly labelled structural links; labels are mandatory, not inferred.
validation: participants limited to object, entity, term, domain (DDN-PF007)
every selected relation carries an explicit author-written label, not the verb default (DDN-PJ104)

profiles.scope: Events and functions strictly alternating through and/or/xor connectors; control flow via epk.next.
validation: participants limited to epk.event, epk.function, epk.connector (DDN-PF007)
events and functions must alternate; event-to-event and function-to-function edges are forbidden (DDN-PJ105)
every epk.connector carries x_epc.operator of and|or|xor; x_epc.operator on a non-connector is forbidden (DDN-PJ106)
EPC symbols have labels, not attribute compartments (DDN-PF003)

profiles.scope: Two market-growth rows (high, low) by two relative-share columns (high, low); quadrant cells are declared relations with value-list content.
validation: exact quadrant category sets per axis (DDN-PJ082)

profiles.scope: Market rows (existing, new) by product columns (existing, new); cells are declared strategy items.
validation: exact quadrant category sets per axis (DDN-PJ082)

profiles.scope: Internal rows (strength, weakness) crossed with external columns (opportunity, threat); cells are strategy notes.
validation: exact quadrant category sets per axis (DDN-PJ082)

profiles.scope: Ordered phase columns; actions/touchpoints/opportunities lanes; one full-width emotions lane whose declared 1..5 values render as a straight-segment polyline.
Ordered release rows (top = first release) by ordered backbone-activity columns; cells are declared analysis.task story objects with provenance.
Entity/table graph where every ref/assoc relation carries explicit crow's-foot source_mark and target_mark cardinality (one, zeroone, many, zeromany).
validation: every view relation is ref or assoc with both cardinality marks (DDN-PJ087)
unsupported: min/max beyond the four marks (use source_min/target_max properties)
schema generation without an allowlist (see RT-020)

profiles.scope: 3..5 horizontal bands stacked widest-at-bottom as trapezoid polygons; centered band labels; optional per-band side annotations from declared items.
validation: band count 3..5 and contiguous one-column rows (DDN-PJ089)

profiles.scope: Two or three declared set panels; members declare x_sets; region labels show declared membership counts at fixed positions.
validation: x_sets present and consistent with panel listings (DDN-PJ091)
unsupported: item names inside regions (counts only in v1)

profiles.scope: Participants in declaration order with lifelines; messages in declaration order with dashed returns and activation bars; record provenance.
validation: message endpoints are selected participant objects (DDN-PJ110)

profiles.scope: Graph layout of interaction participants; author-declared message numbers on relation edges; replies dotted under their request.
validation: every visible uml.message carries a well-formed x_message.seq (DDN-PJ111)
reply numbering is dotted under the request (DDN-PJ111)

profiles.scope: Record instances naming a classifier; slots rendered as field rows; plain assoc links between instances.
validation: instance slots must exist on the classifier when the classifier declares fields (DDN-PJ112)

profiles.scope: Composite states as frames containing substates; dashed parallel regions; boundary-crossing transitions with event/guard labels.
validation: at most one initial state per region (DDN-PJ113)

profiles.scope: Flow nodes plus fork/join bars and object nodes; swimlane partitions as view frames with declared node membership.
validation: node in an unknown partition rejected (DDN-PJ114)

profiles.scope: Pools and lanes as frames; typed start/end events; exclusive/parallel/inclusive gateways; dashed message flow allowed only across pools. Profile-level coverage, not BPMN conformance.
validation: message flow within one pool rejected (DDN-PJ116)

profiles.scope: One band per participant; state plateaus from declared time points; numeric time axis; supplied data only.
validation: x_states present, well-formed and strictly chronological (DDN-PJ118)

profiles.scope: Flowchart of interaction steps; flow nodes may reference other workspace views and render a ref badge; targets are not expanded.
validation: referenced views must exist in the workspace (DDN-PJ119)

profiles.scope: Stages as scoped frames of plan items; rounded milestones; entry/exit sentries on stage membership. Profile-level coverage, not CMMN conformance.
validation: sentries must belong to a stage frame and declare entry/exit (DDN-PJ120)

profiles.scope: Blocks and their associations. Profile-level coverage, not SysML conformance.
Blocks with declared border ports and typed item flows. Profile-level coverage, not SysML conformance.
Constraint blocks carrying formula text, each bound to exactly two endpoints. Profile-level coverage, not SysML conformance.
Fixed nine-kind business/application/technology vocabulary; family-palette layer colours; viewpoints as named views; serving links upward only. Profile-level coverage, not ArchiMate conformance.
validation: relation layer pair must be legal per the fixed 3×3 table (DDN-PJ123)
